title: fix: harden approval signing, session verification and command detection
prompt:
fix: harden approval signing, session verification and command detection

- Pop internal command key unconditionally to prevent leaking into change detection
- Avoid early return on session file changes so unapproved edits and commits are reported
- Bind approval signature verification to the resolved repository path of the session manager
- Allow stop on old completed sessions when the working tree has no uncommitted edits
- Recognize python3.x -m and py -3 -m invocations while excluding wrapped run commands
- Catch save errors gracefully at command boundaries to avoid raw tracebacks
- Add comprehensive forgery, session transfer, and command detection tests

Files changed: guard/agent/events.py, guard/commands/review.py, guard/core/session.py, tests/test_approval_signature.py
